notes: Source = Introduced-in-House (IH) text only; no referencedSources registered on this bill. featured_quotes (Hill, Wagner) are Congressional Record quotes and were NOT audited here — no CR source text is available in the provided source to verify them against. No material fidelity issues found: every figure (7 days, 15 business days, +10 business days, 2 days, age 65/18, 1-year report), entity (SEC/CFTC/CFPB/FINRA/NASAA/Federal Reserve/OCC/FDIC, ICA sec. 22 / 15 U.S.C. 80a-22), and direction (authorize-postponement, opt-in-not-mandate, add-not-repeal) checks out against source. Minor items: the pervasive 'mutual fund' gloss for 'registered open-end investment company'; loose scoping of the demand-deposit-account and internal-review conditions (both belong to the +10-day extension, stated more broadly in top lines); 'not notified of a hold' simplifies the extension-notice exception; '11 cosponsors' is post-introduction metadata (source shows 6 original cosponsors); and two soft framing phrases in likelihoodReason ('bipartisan backing', 'little organized opposition').
